schema:alternativeHeadline: Scan page 25 of Magpie of California, no. 2, vol. 10. Cartoon waiter peeks from beneath an enormous platter or saucer labeled Ramon. Restaurant location map marks 1608 North Cosmo on the east side of Cosmo between Hollywood Boulevard to the north and Selma to the south. Cahuenga runs parallel to the west and Ivar to the east; north is up. Two lots south of Selma offer free parking: the lot between Cosmo and Ivar after 6 p.m., and the lot east of Ivar after midnight.
